The '''FA-4 pilot droid''' was a model of wheeled [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droid]] in operation during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was the predecessor of the [[FA-5 valet droid/Legends|FA-5 valet droid]], both of which were produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]].

==History==
[[File:DookuFA4PilotDroid-AOTC.png|thumb|left|250px|Darth Tyranus and his FA-4.]]
One such [[Droid/Legends|droid]] piloted [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Count Dooku's solar sailer/Legends|solar sailer]] prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Later, in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], FA-4 and FA-5 models could be seen working side-by-side at the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] after the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].
